sectionStandard.title: Standard rules (system-wide)
sectionStandard.desc: These rules apply to EVERY product. Best for units with a truly fixed ratio, e.g. 1 kg = 1000 g.
sectionStandard.riskyNotice: {{count}} rule(s) worth reviewing — they use a packaging unit (pack/box/case) or cross unit categories, which usually differ per product. Consider moving them to per-product rules.

sectionSpecial.title: Special units per product
sectionSpecial.desc: A per-product rule always beats the system-wide rule. Use it when the same unit means different amounts per product, e.g. 1 pack of eggs = 30 eggs but 1 pack of snacks = 12 pcs.

badge.crossCategoryTip: Converts {{from}} to {{to}} — only correct for certain products.
badge.packagingUnitTip: "{{unit}}" is a packaging unit that usually differs per product. {{count}} product(s) currently use it and are all affected by this rule.
badge.overridesGlobalTip: A product-specific rule always beats the system-wide rule — this value is used.

warn.packagingTitle: "{{unit}}" usually means a different amount per product
warn.packagingBody: e.g. 1 pack of eggs = 30 eggs but 1 pack of soda = 12 bottles. With no product selected this rule applies to every product using this unit. Binding it to a specific product is recommended.
warn.crossCategoryBody: Converting {{from}} to {{to}} depends on each product’s density / pack size. As a system-wide rule it lets every product hop between categories.

conflict.title: Conflicting rule
conflict.hint: If the new value is right, remove or fix the rule that produces the old one instead. Saving over it leaves the data contradicting itself, and the answer will differ depending on which unit you ask for.
